title: Prepare initial configurations
action: Construct a diamond (001) slab of 20 layers (6×6 atoms per layer, 720 total atoms) with bottom 4 layers fixed in bulk-terminated positions using lattice constant 3.567 Å. Generate three initial configurations: bulk-terminated (1×1), top-layer atoms pre-moved into dimer pairs for symmetric (2×1), and the symmetric (2×1) structure with third-layer atoms below each dimer row displaced laterally by approximately -0.155 Å along [110] to create the asymmetric (2×1)a structure. Save these structures in LAMMPS data format.
description: Construct the slab and three starting geometries required for subsequent energy minimisations.

title: Energy minimization for symmetric (2×1)
action: Perform energy minimization on the symmetric (2×1) initial configuration using the Tersoff potential for carbon. Save the relaxed atomic coordinates as structure_2x1_sym.xyz (XYZ format, 720 atoms). Record the minimized total energy for later use.
description: Relaxed atomic coordinates of the symmetric (2×1) diamond (001) surface reconstruction.
output_schema: XYZ format: first line atom count 720, second line comment, then rows 'C x y z' in Å.

title: Energy minimization for asymmetric (2×1)a
action: Perform the same energy minimization on the asymmetric (2×1)a initial configuration using the Tersoff potential. Save the relaxed atomic coordinates as structure_2x1a_asym.xyz (XYZ format, 720 atoms). Record the minimized total energy.
description: Relaxed atomic coordinates of the asymmetric (2×1)a diamond (001) surface reconstruction.
output_schema: XYZ format: first line 720, second line comment, then 'C x y z' per atom.

title: Energy minimization for (1×1) relaxation
action: Compute the total energy of the bulk-terminated (1×1) slab (with bottom 4 layers fixed) as the reference unrelaxed bulk energy. Then perform energy minimization to obtain the relaxed (1×1) structure. Save relaxed coordinates as structure_1x1_relaxed.xyz (720 atoms) and record both the reference bulk energy and the minimized total energy.
description: Relaxed atomic coordinates of the (1×1) diamond (001) slab.
output_schema: XYZ format: first line 720, second line comment, then 'C x y z' per atom.

title: Compute energy gains and dimer bond lengths
action: From the total energies recorded during minimizations and the reference bulk energy, calculate the energy gain per surface atom for (1×1) relaxation (relative to unrelaxed bulk), the energy gain per dimer for symmetric (2×1) (relative to relaxed (1×1)), and the energy gain per dimer for asymmetric (2×1)a (relative to relaxed (1×1)). Also compute the dimer bond lengths for the symmetric and asymmetric structures by averaging the distances of top-layer dimer pairs from the corresponding XYZ files. Write all values to results.json.
description: JSON file containing the computed energy gains and dimer bond lengths.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: energy_bulk_terminated (eV), energy_1x1_relaxed (eV), energy_gain_1x1_per_surface_atom (eV), energy_2x1_sym (eV), energy_gain_2x1_per_dimer (eV), energy_2x1a_asym (eV), energy_gain_2x1a_per_dimer (eV), dimer_bond_length_2x1 (Å), dimer_bond_length_2x1a (Å).
